nodes.name: E-Commerce Platform
nodes.designSpec:
element:
  type: landscape
  name: E-Commerce Platform
  description: Full-stack e-commerce system
nodes.documentation:
# E-Commerce Platform
A complete e-commerce system with multiple microservices, databases, and external integrations.

nodes.name: Customer
nodes.designSpec:
element:
  type: person
  name: Customer
  description: End user who shops on the platform
nodes.documentation:
# Customer
A person who browses products, manages their cart, and places orders.

nodes.name: E-Commerce System
nodes.designSpec:
element:
  type: softwareSystem
  name: E-Commerce System
  description: Core e-commerce platform
nodes.documentation:
# E-Commerce System
The core software system containing all e-commerce microservices.

nodes.name: API Gateway
nodes.designSpec:
element:
  type: container
  name: API Gateway
  description: Routes incoming requests to appropriate services
  responsibilities:
    - Request routing
    - Authentication
    - Rate limiting
nodes.documentation:
# API Gateway
The entry point for all client requests. Handles routing, authentication, and rate limiting before forwarding to backend services.

nodes.name: Product Service
nodes.designSpec:
element:
  type: container
  name: Product Service
  description: Manages product catalog and inventory
nodes.documentation:
# Product Service
Manages the product catalog, search, and inventory levels.

nodes.name: Order Service
nodes.designSpec:
element:
  type: container
  name: Order Service
  description: Processes and tracks orders
nodes.documentation:
# Order Service
Handles order creation, payment processing, and order lifecycle management.

nodes.name: Notification Service
nodes.designSpec:
element:
  type: container
  name: Notification Service
  description: Sends emails and push notifications
nodes.documentation:
# Notification Service
Consumes events from other services and sends email/push notifications to customers.

nodes.name: PostgreSQL Database
nodes.designSpec:
element:
  type: dataStore
  name: PostgreSQL
  description: Primary relational database
nodes.documentation:
# PostgreSQL Database
The primary relational database storing products, orders, and user data.

nodes.name: Redis Cache
nodes.designSpec:
element:
  type: dataStore
  name: Redis
  description: Caching and session storage
nodes.documentation:
# Redis Cache
Used for session storage, product catalog caching, and rate limiting counters.

nodes.name: Auth Middleware
nodes.designSpec:
element:
  type: component
  name: Auth Middleware
  description: JWT token validation and user context injection
nodes.documentation:
# Auth Middleware
Validates JWT tokens and injects user context into downstream requests.

nodes.name: Route Handler
nodes.designSpec:
element:
  type: component
  name: Route Handler
  description: Maps incoming routes to backend services
nodes.documentation:
# Route Handler
Determines which backend service should handle each incoming request.

nodes.name: Product Controller
nodes.designSpec:
element:
  type: component
  name: Product Controller
  description: REST endpoint handlers for product operations
nodes.documentation:
# Product Controller
Exposes REST endpoints for CRUD operations on products.

nodes.name: Product Repository
nodes.designSpec:
element:
  type: component
  name: Product Repository
  description: Data access layer for products
nodes.documentation:
# Product Repository
Data access layer that queries PostgreSQL for product data.

nodes.name: Stripe
nodes.designSpec:
element:
  type: externalSystem
  name: Stripe
  description: Payment processing provider
nodes.documentation:
# Stripe
External payment processing service for handling credit card transactions.
